profile.headline: Software Engineer at Gauntlet Labs
profile.summary: I have numerous interests and areas of experience from mobile development to network programming. I work well in both groups and individually and am self-motivated and goal/objective driven. I am not afraid to take on tasks that I do not have much experience with, as I enjoy the challenge of learning new skills. I have very strong written and oral presentation abilities, both technical and non-technical. My main interests are Information Assurance and Network Security, and want to push my career towards Penetration Testing.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
Provide Tier 1-3 support to digital forensics analysts and support the operations and maintenance needs of software tools. Work directly with analysts to troubleshoot and debug any issues in a production environment. Support the operations and maintenance of custom software solutions through the development of hot-fixes and code analysis in a production environment. Mitigate both hardware and software issues encountered by the use of supported software.

Coordinate with users and management to understand and create user requirements to pass along to software development teams. All done in a fast-paced and complex landscape of project requirements and logistical hurdles to produce effective and efficient software solutions and support.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of a small team tasked with designing, building, and testing proprietary software. Gather user requirements and bug reports to direct code changes and feature developments to suit customer needs. Providing direct customer interaction to ensure satisfaction with software releases and future work.

Working with SQLite and SQLServer, C#, Python inside of a Visual Studio environment with code base located in a Gitlab server.
